playstyle.identity: Yone is Yasuo's brother who wields two swords and can leave his body to dive enemies. He has similar Q stacking but with a guaranteed spirit form engage.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive: every 2nd auto deals magic damage. Q thrusts (stacks to dash like Yasuo). W shields and damages in a cone. E leaves body and gains ramping damage - snap back after. R blinks behind enemies and knocks them up. E-R for massive engage, Q3 for knockup.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Yone spikes at level 3 with combo and level 6 for engage. BOTRK and crit scale him. He's strong mid-late with dives.

passive.name: Way of the Hunter
passive.summary: Every second auto deals bonus magic damage; crits deal reduced damage.
passive.details: Every second auto attack deals bonus magic damage. Yone also gains double crit chance from items but crits deal reduced damage.

abilities.name: Mortal Steel
abilities.summary: Thrust forward; at 2 stacks, dash and knock up.
abilities.details: Yone thrusts forward, dealing damage. On hit, he gains a stack. At 2 stacks, the next Q dashes through enemies, knocking them up.

abilities.name: Spirit Cleave
abilities.summary: Slash in a cone, gaining a shield based on enemies hit.
abilities.details: Yone slashes in a cone dealing magic and physical damage. He gains a shield that scales with the number of champions hit.

abilities.name: Soul Unbound
abilities.summary: Leave your body to dive; snap back after, dealing stored damage.
abilities.details: Yone enters spirit form, gaining movement speed and leaving his body behind. After a duration or recast, he snaps back, dealing a percentage of all damage dealt during spirit form.

abilities.name: Fate Sealed
abilities.summary: Blink behind all enemies in a line and knock them up.
abilities.details: Yone blinks forward, pulling all enemies in the path behind him and knocking them up.
